description: This file defines the internal sealed class ActivationRepartitioner which implements IMessageStatisticsSink. It manages message processing, edge processing, and logging within the Orleans runtime's repartitioning system, specifically related to activation repartitioning and message sink functionality.

classes.name: ActivationRepartitioner
classes.description: An internal sealed class responsible for managing message processing, edge processing, and logging within Orleans' activation repartitioning system. Implements IMessageStatisticsSink and handles message filtering, edge creation, and system logging.

methods.name: StartProcessingEdges
methods.description: Begins processing pending message edges asynchronously and logs the start of the service.

methods.name: StopProcessingEdgesAsync
methods.description: Stops the processing of message edges asynchronously, signals cancellation, and logs the stopping of the service.

methods.name: ProcessPendingEdges
methods.description: Continuously drains and processes pending messages, creating edges between grains based on message data, with batching and delay logic.

methods.name: GetMessageObserver
methods.description: Returns a delegate to observe and record messages.

methods.name: RecordMessage
methods.description: Records a message for sampling if it meets criteria, and signals pending message event.

methods.name: FlushBuffers
methods.description: Flushes message buffers asynchronously, waiting until all pending messages are processed.
